title: Baby dragon sneeze fantasy marketplace
prompt_text:
AI Video Prompt

Create a hyper-realistic, cinematic fantasy short film in 16:9 widescreen format, approximately 30 seconds long. Set the scene in a beautiful medieval European village marketplace with traditional stone buildings, wooden houses, colorful flower stalls, warm sunlight, and a magical fantasy atmosphere.

Scene 1 (0–4 seconds): The Magical Dragon
Extreme close-up of a cute, adorable baby dragon with pale pink and white scales, tiny horns, delicate facial spikes, and beautiful glowing golden eyes. A colorful butterfly gently lands on the dragon's nose. The dragon looks curious and slightly cross-eyed, watching the butterfly.

Scene 2 (4–9 seconds): The Curious Girl
Cut to a beautiful young woman with long dark hair, wearing a simple medieval-style outfit. She stands close to the dragon, looking at it with curiosity and a gentle smile. The dragon's nose begins twitching as it prepares to sneeze. Show an extreme close-up of its large nostrils and funny facial expression.

Scene 3 (9–15 seconds): The Unexpected Sneeze
The girl reaches toward the dragon, but suddenly the dragon releases an enormous, powerful sneeze. A magical burst of warm air and glowing particles blasts toward her. Her hair flies wildly backward, her expression changes to complete shock, and her face becomes covered in dark soot and dust. Create a hilarious yet visually spectacular moment with realistic wind physics and detailed facial expressions.

Scene 4 (15–21 seconds): The Dragon at the Fountain
Show the adorable pink dragon standing beside an old stone fountain in the medieval marketplace. The dragon looks innocent and slightly embarrassed. The girl stands nearby, completely messy from the sneeze. Villagers in the background react with surprise and amusement. The dragon lowers its head toward the fountain.

Scene 5 (21–26 seconds): A Magical Moment
The dragon gently approaches the girl. Show the contrast between its enormous cute face and the girl's surprised expression. The dragon behaves playfully and affectionately, creating a charming fantasy moment.

Scene 6 (26–30 seconds): The Sweet Ending
Extreme close-up of the girl's face. She has wet, messy dark hair and a tiny glowing heart-shaped magical mark on her forehead. She looks directly ahead with a surprised but adorable expression. Soft golden sunlight illuminates her face. End with a cinematic close-up and a magical fantasy atmosphere.

Visual Style & Quality:
- Ultra-realistic cinematic fantasy filmmaking.
- Highly detailed dragon skin, scales, eyes, and facial expressions.
- Realistic human facial expressions and natural movements.
- Beautiful medieval European village environment.
- Warm golden-hour lighting.
- Professional cinematic camera angles and smooth transitions.
- Realistic wind, dust, smoke, and magical particle effects.
- Shallow depth of field and professional color grading.
- Consistent character appearance throughout all scenes.
- High-end CGI blended with photorealistic live-action visuals.
- 4K ultra-detailed rendering.

Important: Maintain perfect character consistency. The pink baby dragon and the young woman must look identical throughout the entire video. Ensure smooth scene transitions, natural physics, expressive reactions, and visually coherent storytelling.

title: Korean sci-fi rooftop mech chase
prompt_text:
Video prompt:Cinematic Korean sci-fi action short, live-action look, 24fps, handheld tracking camera, shallow depth of field, hazy daylight.

Shot 1: Rooftop of a worn-out high-rise, cracked concrete, rusty orange railings, scattered rubble, a city skyline in the distance. A Korean high school girl (navy blazer, pleated skirt, black knee socks, long dark wavy hair) sprints away from a group of men in black suits. Rear tracking shot, her hair whipping, her shadow on the ground.

Shot 2: One suited man lunges at her, she dodges. She leaps onto the rusty railing, runs along it, then jumps high into the air in slow motion, with the skyline and sky behind her.

Shot 3: She lands, turns, and faces the camera. Close-up, wind in her hair, cold confident stare, one hand raised in a small finger-heart gesture, suited men blurred in the background.

Shot 4: A giant white-and-grey mech with glowing blue eyes and chest core, battle-worn armor, company logo on the shoulder plates, steps in through a cloud of dust. Low-angle hero shot, the girl tiny in front of it, seen from behind.

Shot 5: Close-up of the girl's face as she shouts back at the robot, then a quick blurred swing of the mech's fist, then a calm closing shot of her smiling gently, uniform neat, with the skyline behind her.

Style: blockbuster Korean action, realistic VFX, cool blue and teal tones, glowing blue accents, sharp motion blur, dramatic lighting. Korean dialogue with English subtitles.

title: Cyberpunk rooftop chase, 4 shots
prompt_text:
Prompt:

Cinematic cyberpunk action sequence, 16:9, four shots, night, heavy rain, neon city.

Shot 1 (0-2s): Low-angle tracking shot. A young woman in a glossy black techwear jacket with glowing cyan seams, short silver bob hair, sprints straight toward the camera across a wet rooftop, splashing through puddles that reflect pink and cyan neon signs, the camera dollying backward fast in front of her.

Shot 2 (2-5s): Side tracking shot, camera running alongside her. She leaps off the roof edge across a wide gap between two skyscrapers, body fully stretched mid-air, giant holographic billboards glowing behind her, a flying car with red taillights streaking past far below.

Shot 3 (5-7s): Close-up from the front as she lands on a metal walkway, rolls over her shoulder and springs back up in one fluid motion, rain droplets flying off her jacket, her eyes flashing with a thin cyan glow.

Shot 4 (7-10s): The camera rises fast into a sweeping drone shot, pulling up and away as she runs and slides under a low glowing pipe, revealing an endless vertical megacity of neon towers, holograms and fog. Fast, dynamic camera movement, motion blur, realistic physics, volumetric neon light, Blade Runner color grade, highly detailed.

Sound: heavy rain, splashing footsteps, distant sirens, deep pulsing synth bass.
